Sikh Truck Driver Stabbed 17 Times in Wyoming; Suspect Charged

A Sikh truck driver was stabbed 17 times at a rest area in Wyoming, United States. The suspect, who has been charged with attempted murder, is in custody. The incident has raised concerns, with one report referencing a Department of Homeland Security (DHS) post about 'Mr Singh'. The attack occurred at a rest stop.
